info.title: nunu.ai API
info.description: The nunu.ai Public API allows you to programmatically interact with your projects, manage test runs, and upload builds.

get.description: List all artifact files (recordings, logs, deliverables) produced by a single run. Each entry includes a download URL pointing back to the Get Artifact File endpoint.

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: Composite run ID, in the format {multiplayerRunId}-{playerNumber} (e.g. lkkg6t5612m-1).

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid API key

403.description: Forbidden - API key does not match the run's project

get.description: Stream a single artifact file produced by a run. The response body is the raw file bytes (not JSON). Range requests, conditional requests via ETag, and presigned redirects for large media files (e.g. .mp4 recordings) are supported.

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: Composite run ID, in the format {multiplayerRunId}-{playerNumber}.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Artifact filename, exactly as returned by List Run Artifacts. May include subdirectories (e.g. deliverables/report.json).

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Standard HTTP range header. Returns 206 for satisfiable ranges and 416 otherwise.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Send the ETag from a previous response to receive 304 Not Modified when the file has not changed.

200.description: Full file body. Content-Type is set based on the artifact's stored type.

206.description: Partial content (response to a Range request)

302.description: Redirect to a presigned URL (typically for large media files)

304.description: Not modified (when If-None-Match matches the current ETag)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid API key

403.description: Forbidden - API key does not match the run's project

404.description: Artifact does not exist or is hidden from the requesting key

filename.description: Artifact filename, including any subdirectories the agent created (e.g. deliverables/report.json).

url.description: Absolute URL to download the artifact. Authenticate the same way you authenticated this list call.

uploaded.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the artifact was written to storage.

etag.description: Object ETag, useful for caching and conditional requests.

runId.description: Echo of the path parameter. Omitted when the run has no artifacts.

count.description: Number of artifacts returned. Omitted when the run has no artifacts.

summary.description: Short summary used by agents to decide whether to read the file.

keywords.description: Searchable keywords associated with the file.

filename.description: Basename of the file (no directory prefix).

path.description: Path of the file relative to the scope root (may include subdirectories).

uploaded.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the file was last written.

metadata.description: Only present when include_metadata=true and a sidecar metadata file exists.

id.description: The agent or test case ID. Omitted for the project section.

count.description: Number of files in this section.
Total number of files across all included sections.

sections.description: One section per scope returned. The project section is always present; other sections only appear when their query param is set.

job_id.description: Job identifier that created this run

multiplayer_run_id.description: Unique identifier for the run (12 lowercase alphanumeric chars)

result.description: Result of the run (null if not completed)

multiplayer_test_id.description: ID of the test to include in the plan

retries.description: Number of retries for this test item

id.description: Unique identifier for the test plan

project_id.description: Project the test plan belongs to

slots.description: Extra deployment slots of a cross-platform test plan (read-only via the API; managed in the test plan editor). Their indices key `slot_deployment_configs` when starting the plan; slot 1 is the implicit default slot.

default_slot_name.description: Optional display name of the implicit default slot (slot 1). Read-only via the API.

test_items.description: Ordered list of tests in this plan

index.description: Slot index (2 or higher; slot 1 is the implicit default slot and is not listed)

name.description: Optional display name. Names are labels only; slots are addressed by index

test_count.description: Number of tests in the plan

test_plan_id.description: ID of the test plan that was executed

total_tests.description: Total number of tests in this execution

pinned.description: Whether the build is pinned (protected from auto-deletion)

nunu_sdk.description: Whether the build includes nunu SDK integration

created_at.description: Timestamp when the build was created

last_used.description: Timestamp when the build was last used in a run

multiplayer_test_id.description: UUID of the test to run (provide this OR test_plan_id OR instructions)

test_plan_id.description: UUID of the test plan to run (provide this OR multiplayer_test_id OR instructions). This endpoint starts test plans with a single deployment config; to supply per-slot configs for a cross-platform plan, use POST /test-plans/{testPlanId}/runs instead.

instructions.description: Test instructions to execute as an ephemeral (one-off) test. Mutually exclusive with multiplayer_test_id and test_plan_id.

deployment_config_id.description: UUID of the deployment configuration, used by every player that has no `player_deployment_configs` entry. Required, except for multiplayer tests where `player_deployment_configs` covers every player.

build_id.description: UUID of a build from Build Storage to use for this run. Only works with build-storage deployment configs, and requires `deployment_config_id`.

player_deployment_configs.description: Per-player deployment configs for cross-platform multiplayer tests, keyed by player number ("1", "2", and so on). Only applies with `multiplayer_test_id`. The map does not need to cover every player: any player without an entry falls back to the default `deployment_config_id`. Omitting `deployment_config_id` is only allowed when every player has an entry; a partial map without a default returns a 400 error. Private device configs are allowed, but every player on a private device needs its own device; if the configs cannot give each player a distinct device, the request returns a 400 error.

deployment_config_id.description: Deployment config to use for this player

build_id.description: Optional Build Storage build for this player (build-storage configs only)

name.description: Display name for the run. Only applies when using instructions. Defaults to '[api] ephemeral test'.

agent_config_id.description: UUID of an agent configuration to use

additional_tags.description: Tags to add to the run. When using instructions (ephemeral), the tag 'api' is automatically prepended.

retries.description: Number of times to retry the test if it fails. Only applies when using multiplayer_test_id.

instances.description: Number of parallel instances to run. Only applies when using multiplayer_test_id.

RunOptions.description: Per-run override knobs. The time budget is intentionally not overridable here; it lives on the test version itself (see `min_seconds` / `max_seconds` on the test body), so callers should edit the test (or create a new version) when they want to change the budget.

mobile_gpslocation.description: GPS location proxy location, either 'auto' or an object with 'lat' and 'long' string properties. Note: 'auto' requires `mobile_geolocation` to be set

StartRunResponse.description: Response body for POST /runs and POST /test-plans/{testPlanId}/runs. Returned with HTTP 201 on success. The body contains the started-run data directly (no { ok, status, message, data } envelope).

job_ids.description: Array of job IDs created. Single test returns 1 job; test plan returns one job per test.

build_id.description: Build ID used for the run. Returned for multiplayer test and test plan runs.

test_id.description: UUID of the created ephemeral test. Only returned for ephemeral (instructions) runs.

test_plan_execution_id.description: Test plan execution ID. Returned for test plan runs.

slot_build_ids.description: For cross-platform test plan runs: the build pinned for each extra slot, keyed by slot index. Only present when slot configs resolved to builds.

message.description: Optional status message returned for multiplayer test and test plan runs.

bug_id.description: Bug identifier (same bug across runs shares this ID)

test_step.description: Test step where bug was detected

ListBugsResponse.description: Bugs detected during a multiplayer run. Bug occurrences per run are naturally bounded, so the response always returns the full list in a single page; the pagination envelope is kept to match the shape of other list routes.

job_ids.description: Array of job IDs to stop

project_id.description: Optional. The project is taken from the URL. If provided, it must match the projectId in the route.

auto_delete.description: Auto-delete old builds when capacity reached

DeleteResponse.description: Standard response for DELETE operations on tests, test plans, and shared steps.

id.description: ID of the deleted resource (echoes the path param)

run_ids.description: 1-50 run identifiers (multiplayer run IDs, composite run IDs, or job IDs)

folder_path.description: Resolved folder path. "/" if at root.

TestCase.description: Full test case body. Shape varies by test_type (verification, discovery, task); see the docs page for the exact shape.

min_seconds.description: Test-level minimum runtime in seconds. Allowed for `discovery` and `task` only; sending this on a `verification` test is rejected with 400. Defaults when omitted: discovery=3600 (1h), task=0. Must be ≤ `max_seconds` (validated against the effective budget after defaults are applied).

max_seconds.description: Test-level maximum runtime in seconds. Hard ceiling for any single run is 19800 (5.5h). Defaults when omitted: verification=19800 (5.5h), discovery=10800 (3h), task=19800 (5.5h).

folder_path.description: Folder path placement. "/" or null = root. Mutually exclusive with folder_id.

folder_id.description: Folder UUID placement. Mutually exclusive with folder_path.

expected_version.description: Version returned by the most recent Get Test.

patch.description: Partial test body. Object fields are deep-merged; arrays are replaced wholesale.
Partial collection body. Cannot change id or is_shared.
Partial test plan body. Object fields are deep-merged; arrays (including test_items) are replaced wholesale.

deployment_config_id.description: UUID of the deployment config for the plan's default slot (slot 1), used by every player not assigned to an extra slot. Required unless the plan's slot assignments cover every player and `slot_deployment_configs` is supplied.

build_id.description: UUID of a build from Build Storage for the default slot. Only works with build-storage deployment configs, and requires `deployment_config_id`.

slot_deployment_configs.description: Per-slot deployment configs for cross-platform test plans, keyed by slot index ("2", "3", and so on; see the plan's `slots`). The key "1" addresses the default slot and cannot be combined with `deployment_config_id`/`build_id`. Every slot used by the plan's player assignments needs an entry. Private device configs are allowed, but every player on a private device needs its own device; if the configs of a test cannot give each of its players a distinct device, the request returns a 400 error.

deployment_config_id.description: Deployment config to use for this slot

build_id.description: Optional Build Storage build for this slot (build-storage configs only)

kind.description: Platform kind (e.g. windows, macos, linux, android, ios, xbox, playstation)
